title: Security
description: Security: records' limits on staff reading, sign-in, records' refusals and compliance findings, as counts. Generated by scripts/gen_security.py; edit that, not this file.

options.content: Counts only: no person, member, tenant or address is on this page. Who is held or frozen, and why: the ops portal, Compliance, Access limits. Alerts show here and on Home; nothing on this laptop pages anyone.

panels.title: Records limits · how many members one person reads
Freezes
panels.description: records froze a staff account: every call that person makes in that tenant is refused until a TPA admin and a compliance officer both clear it. This counts freezes made in the range, not freezes still in force; who is frozen now is on the ops portal (Compliance, Access limits). Ending the person's sessions at auth comes with records' slice S2 and is not logged yet. 'none yet' until records writes its velocity lines (slice R1).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" | decision!="report" | code="velocity_freeze" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Holds
panels.description: records held a staff account past 1.5 times a budget: new members show without details, and lists, searches, downloads and reveals are refused until the window slides or a supervisor lifts it. 'none yet' until records writes its velocity lines.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" | decision!="report" | code="velocity_hold" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Flags
panels.description: A staff account reached a budget (1.0 times): nothing is refused, compliance is told once. 'none yet' until records writes its velocity lines.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" | decision!="report" | code="velocity_flag" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Report only
panels.description: Flags, holds and freezes records would have made in report-only mode (it refuses nothing). Report-only is for production's first weeks; beta and this laptop enforce.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" | decision="report" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Meter failed
panels.description: records could not count a person's reads (velocity meter failed) or could not write a freeze (velocity freeze unwritten). Either way the call was refused: the meter fails closed, so staff cannot work while it fails. Urgent in the cloud. Its exception class is on the Errors page.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"code":"velocity_` | json code | code=~"velocity_(meter_failed|freeze_unwritten)" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: The two local alerts on records' limits (prometheus/rules/home.yml): StaffAccountFrozen (red, for 24h after a freeze) and StaffAccountHeld (amber, for 1h after a hold or a report-only freeze). They show here, on Home and in Grafana's alert list; nothing on this laptop pages anyone (the cloud pages through PagerDuty).

targets.expr: ((count((ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="StaffAccountFrozen"} and (time() - timestamp(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="StaffAccountFrozen"}) < 75))) or vector(0)) > bool 0) * 2 + ((count((ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="StaffAccountHeld"} and (time() - timestamp(ALERTS{alertstate="firing", alertname="StaffAccountHeld"}) < 75))) or vector(0)) > bool 0)

panels.title: Flags, holds and freezes
panels.description: records' velocity lines over time: each is one state change (a flag, a hold or a freeze) of one staff account, enforced or report only. 'none yet' until records writes them.

targets.expr: sum by (code, decision) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" [$__auto]))

panels.title: By role and measure
panels.description: Which staff role crossed which measure (members opened or listed, reveals, in the hour or the day), and what records did. A role reads 'other' when the line named something that is not a staff role (the scrub keeps role names only). No person: who it was is on the ops portal (Compliance, Access limits).

targets.expr: sum by (role, code, measure, decision) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"velocity"` | json code, decision | json role, rc="reason" | code=~"velocity_(flag|hold|freeze)" | label_format measure=`{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^(opened_1h|opened_1d|listed_1h|listed_1d|reveals_1h|reveals_1d|hold_multiplier|freeze_multiplier|lift_minutes|lifts_per_day|mode|unbound_multiplier|admin|compliance)$" .rc "") "" }}{{ .rc }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Calls refused while held or frozen
panels.description: records' refused lines whose reason is velocity_hold or velocity_freeze (403 denied), by operation. 'none yet' until records gives its velocity refusals that reason.

targets.expr: sum by (operation, reason_code) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"refused"` | json rc="reason" | rc=~"velocity_(hold|freeze)" | label_format reason_code=`{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z_]{0,39}$" .rc "") "" }}{{ .rc }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Holds lifted, freezes cleared
panels.description: The people's acts on records' limits: a supervisor lifting a hold for an hour, each half of a freeze's clear (a TPA admin's and a compliance officer's), and the clear itself. Who acted, and for whom, is in records' audit, not here. 'none yet' until records writes these lines.

targets.expr: sum by (code, measure) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"code":"velocity_` | json code | code=~"velocity_(lift|clear_signed|cleared)" | json rc="reason" | label_format measure=`{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^(opened_1h|opened_1d|listed_1h|listed_1d|reveals_1h|reveals_1d|hold_multiplier|freeze_multiplier|lift_minutes|lifts_per_day|mode|unbound_multiplier|admin|compliance)$" .rc "") "" }}{{ .rc }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Limit changes
panels.description: A TPA admin changed records' limits (velocity_settings_changed, one line per field): the role whose figure moved (blank for a tenant setting) and the field. Never the value; who changed it is in records' audit. The cloud pages on these at normal urgency. 'none yet' until records writes these lines.

targets.expr: sum by (role, measure) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `velocity_settings_changed` | json code, role | code="velocity_settings_changed" | json rc="reason" | label_format measure=`{{ if eq (regexReplaceAll "^(opened_1h|opened_1d|listed_1h|listed_1d|reveals_1h|reveals_1d|hold_multiplier|freeze_multiplier|lift_minutes|lifts_per_day|mode|unbound_multiplier|admin|compliance)$" .rc "") "" }}{{ .rc }}{{ else }}other{{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Sign-in refused
panels.description: Password sign-ins auth refused (POST /auth/login answering 401) in the range: a wrong password, an unknown account or a second factor not passed.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/login" | status="401" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Lockouts
panels.description: Every answer of 423 locked from auth (the sign-in family answers 423, never 429).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | status="423" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Step-up refused
panels.description: A signed-in person asked to confirm it was them again (step-up) and auth refused (401 or 403).

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/step-up" | status=~"401|403" [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Sessions ended by admins
panels.description: A TPA admin ended all of a person's sessions (revoke-all) or suspended their login, answered 2xx. A freeze will end sessions too once records' slice S2 lands; those are not counted here.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/admin/principals/{sub}/revoke-all" or route="POST /auth/admin/principals/{sub}/suspend" | status=~"2.." [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Sign-in failures and lockouts
panels.description: auth's request lines: POST /auth/login answering 401, and any 423.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/login" | status="401" [$__auto]))
sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | status="423" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Step-up failures
panels.description: auth's request lines: POST /auth/step-up answering 401 or 403.

targets.expr: sum by (status) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/step-up" | status=~"401|403" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Sessions revoked and logins suspended
panels.description: auth's request lines: an admin's revoke-all and suspend, answered 2xx. The route is a template; who was revoked is in auth's audit, not here.

targets.expr: sum by (route) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="auth"} | route="POST /auth/admin/principals/{sub}/revoke-all" or route="POST /auth/admin/principals/{sub}/suspend" | status=~"2.." [$__auto]))

panels.title: Records gate · refusals, rate limits, reveals, member reads
Refusals by gate and code
panels.description: records' refused lines by gate and code (CONTRACT §7). For security read session_revoked, feed_cold, token_invalid and rate_limited first; a hold or freeze refuses as denied at gate 6.

targets.expr: topk(15, sum by (gate, code) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"refused"` | json gate, code | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: Refusals by code
panels.description: The same refused lines over time, by code.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"refused"` | json code | __error__="" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Rate limited by operation
panels.description: records' rate limited lines (a caller hit its rate class), by operation. The counters are per instance in records today (RS-10).

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"rate limited"` [$__auto]))

panels.title: Reveals served by operation
panels.description: records' operation served lines for its two reveal operations (a secret value shown in full). Per person is on the ops portal.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"operation served"` | operation=~"eligibility[.]reveal|network[.]reveal_field" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Staff member reads
panels.description: Member reads served to staff, a bar per 15 minutes (longer over a range of days), so reading at night shows as night bars: records' operation served lines for the reads its look watch counts (list, search and open a member, the ID card, a member's claims) on a staff door. Not hourly: Grafana would draw the hour now under way after the end of the chart. A true after-hours flag comes with records' slice S6.

targets.expr: sum by (operation) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"operation served"` | operation=~"eligibility[.](list_members|search_members|get_member|member_id_card)|claims[.]list_claims" | json door | door=~"door_(internal|finance|agent)" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Findings
panels.description: records' 'a compliance anomaly was recorded' lines in the range (each is a finding written for compliance to review). The findings are read on records' compliance screens.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"a compliance anomaly was recorded"` [$__range])) or 0 * sum(count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} [$__range]))

panels.title: Anomaly findings by rule
panels.description: The same lines by rule. records does not name the rule on the line yet; its slice S3 adds it as a closed code.

targets.expr: sum by (code) (count_over_time({stack="tpa", service="records"} |= `"message":"a compliance anomaly was recorded"` | json code | code!="" [$__range]))

options.content:
Not on this page yet
  • Sessions ended for a freeze: records asks auth to end them in its slice S2. Until then a freeze refuses every call, and the ops portal's suspend ends the sessions.
  • The anomaly sweep's health: the nightly sweep runs nowhere yet (RS-343); records' slice S3 gives it a line of its own.
  • Cloud only, on the hosted Security page: IAP assertions refused, Cloud Armor denials, perimeter violations, and changes to alerts, counters, secrets and keys.
